description: Write end-to-end scenario tests as a standalone Python script (NOT a daemon). Three canonical flows: (1) New_MCP_Flow: inject a test MCP into mcp_submissions, verify mcp_scanner picks it up, signal_analyser scores it across all 8 signals, trust_synthesiser assigns verdict, attestation_engine creates attestation, UI (port 8790) surfaces verdict — assert all steps complete without error; (2) Verdict_Override_Flow: submit a manual_override_api call for a known MCP, verify mcp_decisions records the override with analyst metadata, audit_log captures the action; (3) Threat_Intel_Flow: inject a known-threat signal via threat_intel_ingestor, verify risk_ranker promotes server to HIGH_RISK_ISOLATED, verify attestation is revoked. Use write_service for all DB operations. No direct duckdb. Exit 0 on all pass, exit 1 on any failure. Include docstring citing ZO-SENTINEL Product Specification v1.0.
